verdict.rationale: Grafana's evidence strongly supports backend-agnostic querying, visualization, and alerting across many data sources (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, CloudWatch, etc.) and mixing data sources per-query, which supports the 'switch backends without re-instrumenting' half of the story. However, no evidence explicitly addresses OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation standards or confirms that OTel-instrumented telemetry can be freely repointed across backends without code changes — Grafana Alloy (an OTel collector) is only briefly mentioned once (docs-29) without detail. missing for 10: explicit OTel instrumentation-standard support/documentation, evidence of code-level portability across backends via OTel SDKs, and independent confirmation that switching backends requires no re-instrumentation.
